_comment: Device profiler overhead CI golden (Wormhole, wh_n300_civ2). ARMED: real_time values are real measurements captured on wh_n300_civ2 CI silicon (ENABLE_TRACY=ON, WITHOUT TT_METAL_PROFILER_ACCUMULATE, min aggregate, single-run centers). The runtime_perf_profiler_overhead CI job runs compare_profiler_overhead_ci.py WITHOUT --ignore-times, so metrics with a numeric real_time are gated at +/-tolerance (default 25%). BM_profiler_read (the ReadMeshDeviceProfilerResults L1->DRAM writeout; dominant ~7.3-7.5ms, cv<6%) is gated. BM_profiled_dispatch (profiler-enabled EnqueueMeshWorkload+Finish) is left record-only (real_time=null -> tracked, not gated): its host-side jitter on Wormhole is too high to gate (cv 18-28%). To gate dispatch later, stabilize it (more iterations) and populate a numeric real_time.
